{{main|2026 Lisboa Belém Open}}

[[Vilius Gaubas]] was the defending champion<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://tennistourtalk.com/126263/gaubas-crowned-lisboa-belem-open-champion|title=Gaubas Crowned Lisboa Belem Open Champion|first=Florian|last=Heer|date=September 28, 2025}}</ref> but lost in the first round to [[Marco Cecchinato]].
